'''Keyo-So''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He held a conversation with the [[Albathius|Shining Man]] that was recorded in his [[Vitalicron/Legends|vitalicron]].<ref name="The Wellspring of Healing" />
